capture_note: 142 actual native iPhone XCTest stills: 36 screen-family examples and 106 default-state isolated previews across 53 routes, in light and dark. Original local fixture imagery only.
transformations: Lossless WebP at original native pixel resolution. 82 isolated previews omit only recorded status-bar regions. Primitive, semantic and composite previews additionally omit exact-uniform trailing background, retaining at least 48 native pixels after the last non-background row with paired light/dark alignment. Shell, foundation, native recipes and screen-family bottom extents are unchanged. No resizing, retouching, redrawing or invented UI.
scope_limits: Still images show only the captured visible state and platform; interaction coverage and fidelity acceptance are separate.
Native controls are in their visible resting state. Menu, picker, presentation and share launcher images do not prove open controls or completed actions.
Foundation token roles and corner geometry are diagnostic samples, not standalone runtime components.
Screen-family captures use original-suite attachment provenance without generic emitted component bindings; binding is explicitly null.
Emitted component bindings retain visual_review=pending. Publication inspection does not rewrite native evidence.
